decision.finding: Whole-GQA ownership only pays when paired with cooperative matrix parallelism. Scalar exact QK serializes nine queries, the eight-block grid underfills gfx1151, and the 44.5-KB LDS footprint limits residency.
decision.next_gate: Do not retry scalar whole-GQA owners. Any new comparator-shaped attention path must use genuinely cooperative higher-precision QK/PV or supply an independently valid error bound.
